remarks: The Key To Your Dream Home in Tonawanda is here 119 Bannard Ave! Location is ideal off of Delaware Ave, close to the thruway & all your shopping & dining needs.Neighborhood features tree lined streets, sidewalks to explore & leads to Cardinal O' Hara High School.Charming 2-story Cape Cod in the Kenmore-Tonawanda School District offers 3 beds, 1.5 baths and 1,573 sq ft of well-maintained living space w/ a versatile floor plan designed for everyday comfort & entertaining. Beautiful curb appeal features lush landscaping, maintenance-free vinyl siding, an extra-wide blacktop driveway and an impressive oversized attached 2-car garage.Step inside to gleaming hardwood floors and a warm, inviting front living room accented by built-in shelving and an abundance of natural light. A sliding glass door leads to the covered deck/awning, extending the living space outdoors and overlooking the fully fenced backyard. The first-floor bedroom with closet provides excellent flexibility and can also serve as a formal dining room, home office or additional living space, as virtually staged.The bright eat-in kitchen offers plenty of cabinetry and counter space, tile flooring and a spacious dining area surrounded by windows overlooking the yard. Just beyond the kitchen is an additional family/living room featuring a gas fireplace and convenient access between the home and garage—creating a comfortable gathering space and great flow for entertaining.Upstairs, two spacious bedrooms share a hallway full bath with tub/shower combination. The poured-foundation basement is clean and dry with excellent potential for a future finished rec room, playroom, fitness area or additional entertaining space, as virtually staged.A standout feature is the oversized attached 2-car garage with a rear overhead door opening directly to the fully fenced yard. Utilize the garage as traditional parking/storage or open it to the backyard for an impressive indoor/outdoor entertaining setup. Updated roof and select mechanical updates add peace of mind. A lovingly maintained home offering character, flexibility and plenty of space to make your own!Home has been virtually staged for design and layout.
